de.fzi.sim.kascpar.sc2ast
Class SymtabManager

java.lang.Object
  de.fzi.sim.kascpar.sc2ast.SymtabManager

public class SymtabManager
extends java.lang.Object

Manages the symbol table and scopes within a given compilation unit.

Method Detail

OpenScope

public static Scope OpenScope(java.lang.String scopeName,
                              boolean isType)
Opens a new scope (with optional name and type flag).

Parameters:
scopeName - the name to set. The new scope will be created with this name. If the scopeName is null, the routine creats a unnamed scope.
isType - the boolean flag is used to control a type of the created object. It can be object of the Scope (isType == false) or the ClassScope (isType == true) type.
Returns:
the new object of the Scope or the ClassScope type.
See Also:
Scope, ClassScope

PutTypeName

public static void PutTypeName(java.lang.String tname)

IsFullyScopedTypeName

public static boolean IsFullyScopedTypeName(java.lang.String name)
Tests if the specified name is a fully scoped type. The method tries to find all scopes in name and then searchs a type in scope type table. For instance, A::B::MyType, where A, B are scopes, MyType - is a type and it is searched in type table of the scope B;

Parameters:
name - - possible type.
Returns:
true if and only if the specified name is a fully scoped type, false otherwise.

IsTypeName

public static boolean IsTypeName(java.lang.String name)
Tests if the specified name is a type. For that the method searchs this type in the current scope, then continues in the super class scopes.

Parameters:
name - - a possible type.
Returns:
true if the specified name is a type, false otherwise.
See Also:
Scope, ClassScope

GetScopeOfScopedName

public static Scope GetScopeOfScopedName(java.lang.String scope_name)
Returns the scope object of the scope name. For instance, the method returns C in "A::B::C" or C in "C" if C is a nested scope in the current scope.

Parameters:
scope_name - - a scope or a scoped name.
Returns:
a found scope object, null otherwise.
